original_query: Which country spend the most in Mobile display ads in 2013, according to IAB Europe AdEx Benchmark (2013)?

summaries.found_via_query: IAB Europe AdEx Benchmark 2013 mobile display ads spending by country
summaries.summary: A table from the IAB Europe AdEx Benchmark 2013 shows mobile display ad spend in €m for various countries in 2013, along with year-over-year growth, total online display ad spend, and mobile display as a share of total online display. Turkey leads with the highest mobile display ad spend at €7.6m.
key_facts: Turkey spent €7.6m on mobile display ads in 2013.
The data is from IAB Europe AdEx Benchmark 2013.
Other countries listed include Czech Republic (€5.0m), Hungary (€4.1m), Poland (€3.6m), etc.
Romania had the highest YoY growth at 244.9%.
Mobile display as a share of total online display is highest in Serbia at 4.6%.
